name: Brew of Fortification
effect: This move can only be used when your Stagger Bar is at 80% or higher. Clear your Stagger Bar. Gain a Temporary HP shield equal to your Dexterity. In addition, one enemy **must** target you on their next turn. This move cannot be used for 5 turns. Each turn you use Blackout Kick, this lowers the cooldown of this move by 1 turn.
description: You take a deep drink of your brew, hardening your resolve!
